en.name: Beef broth, stock or consommé (commercial)
en.summary: Beef broth, stock and consommé are sold as cans, cartons, concentrates and cubes, all of them simmered down from roasted bones and connective tissue. A well-made one sets to a wobbling jelly in the fridge — that is collagen turned to gelatine, not a fault. Unopened, the pack keeps to the use-by date printed on it. Chilled, broth runs about 7 days, dropping to 3–4 days once opened, and it freezes for about 2–3 months.
en.pantry: A sealed can or carton has no cupboard countdown of its own; the printed use-by date is the answer, provided it sits somewhere cool, dark and dry. A shelf above the hob or a sunny windowsill will age the flavour long before that date arrives. Cut the pack open and the protection is gone: what you have is a low-acid liquid carrying dissolved beef protein, the exact conditions Clostridium perfringens multiplies in as a pot cools slowly. Get leftovers into the fridge within 2 hours, or within 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F), and never leave a stockpot on a switched-off hob overnight.
en.fridge: Decant it out of the opened can into a sealed jar or tub and keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. An opened can or carton gives you about 3–4 days; broth sold chilled, or one you have made and cooled yourself, runs about 7 days. Two things happen in the cold and neither is spoilage: the stock stiffens into a jelly, and the beef fat floats up and sets into a pale cap. Leave that cap alone — it seals the surface from air — and lift it off only when you are ready to use what is underneath. Bring the temperature down fast before it goes in: a shallow tub, or the pot stood in a sink of iced water, crosses the 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) danger zone far quicker than a deep pot will. Reheat by the ladleful, to a full boil.
en.freezer: Beef stock survives freezing better than most liquids because the gelatine holds the water in place; it thaws back into stock rather than into water with sediment in it. Portion it into rigid tubs or bags laid flat at −18 °C (0 °F), leaving headspace for expansion, and it holds about 2–3 months of good quality. At that temperature it stays safe indefinitely, so the figure is a flavour one — the deep roasted note is the first thing to flatten. Press the jellied stock into ice-cube trays as well, because one cube melted into a pan turns the fond into a glaze.
en.thawing: Move it into the fridge the night before, or tip the frozen block straight into a hot pan and let it collapse. Do not leave it on the worktop to soften. Either way, take it to a rolling boil before it goes anywhere near a plate.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly dented can — discard without opening
Cloudiness, ropy strands or a slimy texture in what should be a clear liquid
A sour, fermented or off smell
Bubbles or fizzing in a container that is not meant to be carbonated
tips: Decant an opened can into a glass or plastic container straight away.
Freeze in the portion sizes you actually cook with, and label them.
Cool broth fast in a shallow dish rather than slowly in a deep pot.
Keep bouillon cubes and concentrate in the cupboard as the long-life standby; the reconstituted broth lasts 3-4 days in the refrigerator.

faq.q: How long does opened beef broth last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–4 days once the carton or can is opened, kept at 4 °C or below in a sealed container. Fresh refrigerated broth runs about 7 days.
Yes. Portion it with headspace and freeze at −18 °C for about 2–3 months of good quality.

faq.q: How long does an unopened carton of beef broth keep?
faq.a: There is no fixed timeline — go by the use-by date printed on the package, stored cool and dry.

faq.q: Can you store broth in the opened can?
faq.a: No. Transfer it to a sealed glass or plastic container; once air reaches the can the broth picks up a metallic taste.

zh.name: 市售牛高湯
zh.summary: 市售牛高湯有罐頭、利樂包、濃縮液和高湯塊等形式，全都是用烤過的牛骨和帶筋部位長時間熬出來的。熬得好的冰過會凝成會晃動的凍，那是膠原蛋白變成明膠，不是壞掉。未開封的以包裝上印的有效日期為準；冷藏約 7 天，開封後掉到 3～4 天，冷凍約 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 沒開封的罐頭或紙盒沒有自己的櫥櫃天數，包裝上印的日期就是答案，前提是收在陰涼、避光、乾燥的地方。擺在爐台正上方或曬得到太陽的窗邊，風味會比日期先老掉。一旦開封，這層保護就沒了：手上是一鍋低酸、溶著牛肉蛋白的液體，正是產氣莢膜梭菌在整鍋慢慢放涼時最會繁殖的環境。喝不完的要在 2 小時內進冰箱，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮短到 1 小時，也絕對不要把整鍋留在熄火的爐子上過夜。
zh.fridge: 倒出罐外，裝進密封的玻璃罐或保鮮盒，放 4 °C 以下。開過的罐頭或紙盒大約 3～4 天；冷藏販售的、或自己熬好放涼的，大約 7 天。冰箱裡會發生兩件事，都不是壞掉：湯會凝成凍，牛油會浮上來結成一層白色的油蓋。那層油蓋先別動，它把空氣隔在外面，要用的時候再掀開。進冰箱前先把溫度降下來——分裝到淺容器，或把鍋子坐進裝冰水的水槽，都比一整深鍋更快穿過 4～60 °C 這段危險溫度帶。每次只舀要用的量加熱，而且要煮到大滾。
zh.freezer: 牛高湯比一般湯汁耐凍，因為明膠會把水分抓住，解凍後回到的是高湯，而不是一攤水加渣。分裝進硬盒或平放的密封袋，留膨脹空間，放 −18 °C，良好品質約可維持 2～3 個月。這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，所以那是風味期限——最先變淡的就是那股烤骨頭的厚味。也可以把凝成凍的高湯壓進製冰盒，做醬汁時丟一塊下去，鍋底的焦香就化成亮亮的醬汁。
zh.thawing: 前一晚移到冷藏慢慢化，或把凍塊直接丟進熱鍋讓它化開。不要放在流理台上回溫。不管哪一種，上桌前都要煮到大滾。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重凹陷——不要開，直接丟掉
本該清澈的湯變濁、出現絲狀物或黏稠感
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或異味
不該有氣泡的容器裡出現氣泡或冒氣
tips: 開罐後立刻移到玻璃或塑膠容器。
按實際下廚會用到的份量分裝冷凍，並貼標籤。
用淺盤快速降溫，不要用深鍋慢慢放涼。
櫥櫃常備高湯塊或濃縮高湯當長效備品；泡開後的高湯在冰箱可以放 3-4 天。

faq.q: 開封的牛高湯放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 紙盒或罐頭開封後，密封放 4 °C 以下大約 3～4 天。市售冷藏高湯則大約 7 天。
可以。留膨脹空間分裝後放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2～3 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的牛高湯可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有固定天數——以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥處。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。請移到密封的玻璃或塑膠容器；空氣接觸罐身後，高湯會帶金屬味。
